Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python / React)

Location: Remote (US-based)
Experience: 6+ years

About Us:
At CloudTech Solutions, we build scalable microservices for logistics. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep experience in Python and JavaScript to lead our backend architecture and help mentor junior team members.

Responsibilities:
- Design, architect, and deploy high-throughput microservices using Python (FastAPI/Django) and Go.
- Maintain frontend applications built in React and TypeScript.
- Collaborate with product managers, QA, and DevOps to streamline CI/CD pipelines.
- Lead architectural reviews and promote best engineering practices across teams.
- Optimize PostgreSQL queries and maintain Elasticsearch clusters.

Requirements:
- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- Expert proficiency in Python and modern Web frameworks.
- Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript and frontend state management.
- Hands-on experience with AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS, RDS).
- Demonstrated leadership ability or experience mentoring engineers.

Benefits:
- 100% Remote work flexibility
- Unlimited PTO and competitive health coverage
- $3,000 annual learning stipend

Junior Frontend Developer
Location: Austin, TX (In-Office 5 days/week)

We are looking for an entry-level Frontend Developer to join our team in Austin. You will work closely with senior engineers to craft responsive UI components using JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

Requirements:
- 0-2 years of software development experience
- Proficiency in modern JavaScript (ES6+)
- Basic understanding of React or Vue
- Must be able to work on-site at our downtown Austin headquarters

Lead Backend Systems Engineer (Go)
Location: New York, NY (2 days in office, 3 days remote)

FinTech Corp is seeking a Lead Engineer to manage our core transactions team. You will lead a squad of 5 developers and architect high-frequency trading pipelines written in Go (Golang).

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead squad delivery and technical direction
- Build ultra-low latency services using Go and gRPC
- Collaborate with risk and compliance teams

Experience:
- 8+ years total software experience, 3+ years in Go
- Hybrid schedule: 2 days in our Manhattan office required

Software Engineer II - C# / .NET
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

Join our Enterprise Solutions group as a Mid-level Software Engineer. You will build and maintain core cloud services using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Azure SQL.

Qualifications:
- 3-5 years of professional experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem
- Solid understanding of REST APIs and relational databases
- Hybrid work model (3 days in Chicago office per week)
